summary: This benchmark evaluates two-site linear feature transplantation from Qwen2.5-Coder-7B into a frozen Qwen2.5-72B recipient on arithmetic carry tasks in Python functions. The methodology is well-isolated with rigorous controls, including equal-norm orthogonal edits and full-state swaps, demonstrating successful multi-operand composition across model scales. With detailed hardware and software configurations provided, the study represents a solid empirical contribution to mechanistic interpretability.
strengths: Rigorous experimental controls, specifically isolating directional specificity by contrasting aligned edits against equal-norm orthogonal null controls and full-state replacement baselines.
Bidirectional validation testing both 1-to-2 digit (742/743) and 2-to-1 digit (743/743) transitions across four paired prompt variants to prevent spurious carry triggers.
Comprehensive reproducibility documentation detailing exact model checkpoint hashes, layer boundaries, matrix operations, peak memory allocations, and hardware/software environments.
Candid reporting of methodological limitations, explicitly noting the confounding variables between the 32B and 72B comparison setups rather than overclaiming scale-only effects.
weaknesses: The evaluation scope is constrained to synthetic two-digit Python addition tasks, leaving open whether multi-site donor feature transfer generalizes to more complex programmatic or reasoning logic.
Evaluation relies strictly on greedy argmax token paths, without assessing sampling temperature sensitivity or varied natural language phrasing.
The repository was not bundled as a verified code artifact through the submission platform, requiring badge classification as text_only.
suggestions: Evaluate multi-site feature transplantation across broader reasoning benchmarks, such as multi-step arithmetic or logical deductions, to test the universality of the coordinate alignment.
Disentangle the alignment fitting method from model scale by applying the contrast-derived alignment retroactively to the 32B recipient for a direct apples-to-apples ablation.
Provide sampling-based generation metrics alongside greedy decoding to evaluate distributional robustness against logit perturbations.

novelty_vs_existing.title: Transferring Linear Features Across Language Models With Model Stitching
novelty_vs_existing.contribution: Extends single linear feature and SAE transfer between language models to simultaneous multi-operand activation injection across two token positions to drive compositional symbolic execution (arithmetic carry) in a 72B parameter recipient.
